name: browser-use
headline: awesome-claude: curated Anthropic Claude tools
short_description: A curated list of resources and tools for Anthropic Claude. Useful for developers and operations teams working with Claude AI. Integrates with TypeScript workflows and supports Claude agents.
author: tonysurfly

sections.overview:
Awesome-Claude is a comprehensive curated list of resources, tools, and integrations for working with Anthropic's Claude AI. It serves as a reference directory for developers and operations teams building Claude-based applications and agents. The repository organizes Claude-related resources into clear categories with contribution guidelines, making it easier to discover relevant tools and libraries. It includes integrations and examples that support Claude workflows across different development environments. The collection is maintained with automated quality checks and follows structured awesome-list standards for consistency and discoverability.
Automate code generation for repetitive programming tasks to save time and reduce errors.
Integrate Claude AI into development environments for real-time coding assistance and debugging.
Utilize Claude's reasoning capabilities to analyze complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
Create customized workflows that leverage Claude's AI to enhance team collaboration and project management.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/tonysurfly/awesome-claude`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a curated list of resources and tools for [TOOL/LANGUAGE, e.g., 'Anthropic Claude'] that includes: official documentation, community libraries, debugging tools, and automation scripts. Focus on resources that integrate with [WORKFLOW, e.g., 'TypeScript workflows'] and support [SPECIFIC FEATURE, e.g., 'Claude agents']. Prioritize open-source tools and include links where possible. Format the output as a numbered list with brief descriptions for each item.
```
Copy

```
Here’s a curated list of resources and tools for Anthropic Claude, tailored for TypeScript developers and operations teams working with Claude agents:

1. **Claude SDK for TypeScript (v1.2.0)** – Official TypeScript bindings for the Claude API, including type definitions and async/await support. GitHub: [claude-sdk-ts](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-sdk-ts).

2. **Claude CLI (v0.5.1)** – Command-line interface for managing Claude agents, deployments, and logs. Features include agent templating and real-time monitoring. Install via `npm install -g @anthropic/claude-cli`.

3. **Claude Debugger (v2.1.0)** – Open-source debugger for Claude agents, supporting breakpoints, step-through execution, and state inspection. Works with VS Code and WebStorm. GitHub: [claude-debugger](https://github.com/claude-community/claude-debugger).

4. **Claude Agent Templates** – Pre-built agent templates for common workflows (e.g., customer support, data processing). Includes TypeScript examples and Docker configurations. Repository: [claude-agent-templates](https://github.com/claude-templates/agent-templates).

5. **Claude Log Analyzer (v1.0.3)** – Tool for parsing and analyzing Claude agent logs to identify performance bottlenecks or errors. Outputs JSON or CSV for further analysis. GitHub: [claude-log-analyzer](https://github.com/claude-logs/analyzer).

6. **Claude VS Code Extension (v0.8.2)** – VS Code extension for syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and agent management directly in the editor. Marketplace: [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=anthropic.claude-vscode).

7. **Claude Terraform Provider (v0.3.0)** – Terraform provider for deploying and managing Claude agents in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure). Docs: [Terraform Registry](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/anthropic/claude/latest).

8. **Claude Community Slack** – Active Slack community for sharing best practices, troubleshooting, and collaborating on open-source tools. Join: [claude-community.slack.com](https://claude-community.slack.com).

For operations teams, I recommend combining the `claude-cli` with the `claude-debugger` for deployment and monitoring. Developers should explore the `claude-sdk-ts` and `claude-vscode` extension for seamless integration into TypeScript workflows.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
